_comment: GenXEvo AI Automation Agent - JavaScript Selenium.
Copy this file to genxevo.config.json in your workspace and edit it.
EVERY VALUE BELOW IS THE BUILT-IN DEFAULT. An empty file behaves identically,
and a test in this repository asserts that this claim stays true.
JSON has no comments, so any key beginning with an underscore is treated as one
and never reported as a typo.
workspace.roots is deliberately empty: GenXEvo never infers the workspace.
The folder you pass to --workspace is always the first root.

workspace._comment: Which folders the agent may touch. Everything outside is refused.

project._comment: Escape hatches for an ambiguous project. null or empty means discover it.

execution._comment: Phase 1D. Off by default: running a project s tests runs that project s code.

browser._comment: Phase 1C. implicitWaitMs must be 0; mixing waits produces unpredictable timing.

evidence._comment: How observations are captured and stored under .genxevo/.

security._comment: Redaction, untrusted framing and the file deny-list. Emptying deniedFileGlobs removes every credential-file protection and is reported loudly.

repair._comment: Phase 1E. An unbounded repair loop is the failure mode maxCyclesPerFailure prevents.
